## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/chatgpt/responses/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['validate ChatGPT environment and return headers with access token, account ID, and session ID', 'transform a ChatGPT Responses API request with default instructions, streaming enabled, and encrypted reasoning content included', 'parse a ChatGPT SSE response stream and extract the completed response with header metadata', 'build the complete ChatGPT Responses API URL by appending /responses to the base URL', 'check whether ChatGPT Responses API supports native WebSocket connections']
```

```

```
